modules.name: Probe (P3)
modules.description: Not an instrument. Plays the engine's test fixtures and checks itself: clock in, reset in, gate out, and the drums' mix out

modules.name: Rhythm
modules.description: The tiny rhythm machine: sixteen sounds, sixteen steps. Each sound's trigger and voice out on sixteen channels, and back in through RETURN; a gate for each effect, with a send and return round them; each sound's two slider voltages out and in. Its effects' filter, soft clip and sample-rate reducer are ported from Emilie Gillet's stmlib and Plaits (MIT, (c) Emilie Gillet)
